snippet.title: Paper Shredder - Official Release Window Trailer | ID@Xbox Fall 2026
snippet.description:
Check out the Paper Shredder trailer to see gameplay from this upcoming incremental game. Shred your company's paperwork to earn a $1,000,000 payout.

Paper Shredder is an incremental game where a sheet-after-sheet grind scales into mass document destruction. Shred, sweep, upgrade, and cut down tower-high piles of confidential records to uncover what’s buried beneath. 

If you want the job, Paper Shredder is coming to Xbox Series X|S, Xbox on PC, and Xbox Play Anywhere this winter 2026. It is also coming to PC (Steam).

#IGN #Gaming #Xbox
